title: Green and efficient iron-catalyzed cross-dehydrogenative coupling for the synthesis of α,β-unsaturated ketones via C(sp3)–H functionalization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20623-20628
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01979F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Manjit Singh, Poonam Rajesh Prasad
An efficient green method for synthesizing α,β-unsaturated ketones via C(sp3)–H functionalization of acetophenone and methylarene was developed using FeCl3·6H2O in DMF under air.
